admin_backend.admin.html: Admin dashboard for managing inventory (secured via concierge modal)
admin_backend.admin.js: Handles admin UI, CRUD functions, API integration
admin_backend.admin.css: Custom styling for admin panel (optional if scoped within main styles)
admin_backend.api.js: API interaction layer for CRUD (GET/POST/PUT/DELETE) with MongoDB backend
admin_backend.server.js: Express.js Node server (routes, middleware, CORS, body-parser setup)
admin_backend.models/Product.js: Mongoose schema for products, categories, brands
admin_backend.routes/products.js: RESTful API routes for product CRUD operations
admin_backend..env: Secure config for DB URI, admin token, etc.

database.seed.js: MongoDB seeder for initial product dataset (based on products.json)

media_submission.demo-video.mp4: Walkthrough demo of full SPA + admin CRUD (mid/final submission)
media_submission.TempusPrivee_Report.pdf: PDF report explaining architecture, features, challenges, improvements
media_submission.README.md: Documentation with setup instructions, dependencies, etc.

optional_enhancements.auth.js: Token-based or password-based admin authentication (for API protection)
optional_enhancements.search.js: Modularized search engine (if decoupling from main.js)
optional_enhancements.wishlist.js: Separate script if wishlist grows in functionality
optional_enhancements.analytics.js: (Optional) Basic user interaction tracking for demo purposes
